decisions.reason: The XL package is a low-cost tier extension of the existing anamnesis app that serves large and multi-site practices, so keeping this option open costs little while demand from growing dental groups is still uncertain.

The dedicated support service for dental assistants builds on the firm's core strength in customer service, has its own web page showing commitment, and is cheap to maintain alongside the established support offer, so there is no evidence yet to justify abandoning it.
